Sky Sports reported that the Nigeria international has already told his representatives that he wants to leave Leverkusen in the winter.
The 24-year-old has found regular playing time difficult to secure at the former Bundesliga champions this season.
So far, he has managed only a five-minute appearance for Die Werkself, prompting his desire to seek more minutes elsewhere on a temporary basis.
Boniface’s reported request signals that he is prioritising first-team football as he looks to leave Leverkusen in January.
